privacy.p-1.text: This website is served by LM Warden, self-hosted by the operator of this site. It has no accounts, no forms and no comments, so the only personal data it can touch is what a visit itself reveals.

privacy.p-2.text: The operator of this site uses Google Analytics 4 to count visits and see which pages people read.{{privacy_ads}} Three actions are recorded: copying the install command, and following a link to GitHub or to PodWarden.

privacy.p-3.text: On your first visit a banner asks whether you allow analytics cookies. Until you choose, and if you decline, Google’s tag runs in its consent mode: it sets no cookies and sends Google only anonymous, cookieless signals that cannot identify you across visits. If you accept, Google sets its analytics cookies (named _ga and similar), which last up to two years.

privacy.p-4.text: Use cookie settings to see the banner again, or clear this site’s data in your browser. Your choice is kept in your browser’s local storage under lmw-consent.

privacy.p-5.text: Google LLC processes the measurement data under its own terms; see how Google uses information from sites that use its services.{{privacy_contact}}

privacy.p-6.text: The LM Warden software itself sends nothing to its authors or to Google. Only this public website, where its operator has entered a tracking ID, loads Google’s tag.
